map_features.note: Declared 146 E to 142 E offshore north-New-Guinea surface reference reach, ordered northwestward for the trade-wind convention. Both gates and every vertex are selected by OSW. Excludes southeast coastal continuation, Vitiaz Strait, Halmahera branches and the deeper New Guinea Coastal Undercurrent; not a whole-current endpoint or observed axis.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

scope_notes.label: Local seasonal direction and El Niño exception
scope_notes.source_locator: Data and Method, sections 3.2–3.3 / Figures 4 and 9 captions
scope_notes.summary: Local upper-ocean direction composite reverses southeastward November–April to northwestward May–October. Three-cycle sampling, gaps and El Niño exceptions limit annual interpretation. Direction symbols are not current axes or measured seasonal lengths/widths.

widths.boundary_rule: Author-described surface vein span. Exact seasonal velocity-anomaly threshold and paired geographic edges not specified in this descriptor. Figure 3 half-maximum anomaly-standard-deviation region is a different operator.
widths.extraction_method: Author prose values transcribed from visually reviewed original. No velocity/SST edges digitized and no averaging of regional descriptors.
widths.geographic_scope: Surface current-anomaly vein east of Vitiaz Strait, near southern New Britain; excludes the strait itself.
widths.layer: Surface altimetric current anomaly or SST-associated surface water-mass vein, depending on metric. No uniform depth slab; 50-100 m upwelling and deeper NGCUC support not transferred.
widths.name: New Guinea Coastal Current

original_regional_context.display_caption: East of Vitiaz Strait / track 099: approximately 120 km. Trade-wind / austral-winter description, illustrated by August seasonal fields. Current-anomaly vein, not full-depth or instantaneous current width.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: 2001–2010 seasonal climatology context; exact width dates, paired edges and uncertainty unresolved. Figure 3 variability-envelope widths, 80/340 km SLA smoothing, core displacement and offshore core position remain distinct metrics. No seasonal width animation inferred.
